title: Split the billsplit Dart files under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring all four over-cap billsplit Dart sources and its 536-line UI flow test under the cap, leaving only Flutter's generated Windows runner.
acceptance_criteria: Every billsplit Dart file is at most 250 lines.
flutter test reports exactly 60 passing tests, the same as before the split.
flutter analyze reports no MORE issues than the pre-split baseline. That baseline is 4 pre-existing unnecessary_unawaited infos, measured from a detached worktree at HEAD rather than assumed.
Library-private declarations that cross a seam use part/part of. A `library;` directive must come before any `part`.
No test is deleted, skipped or weakened.
out_of_scope: windows/runner/win32_window.cpp, which is Flutter-generated scaffolding that regeneration would overwrite.
The 4 pre-existing unnecessary_unawaited infos, which are not this task's to fix.
verifier: flutter test (expects 60 passed), flutter analyze compared against the same command run in a detached worktree at HEAD, and check_file_length.sh over billsplit.
